visualCharacteristics: Grey-section, 3-up grid of tall blue interactive quiz cards. Each card has an eyebrow label (e.g. 'Myth or reality?'), an illustration, a large question, a set of answer-option pill buttons, and a 'Get the facts' CTA.
contentPattern: Container block, one row per card: image cell + text cell (eyebrow + question + options list + CTA).
usage: Use for a row of interactive knowledge-check quiz cards.
